references.text: Balak had previously sent messengers to Balaam with a promise of great honor, which he refers to here when asking why Balaam did not come.
The first sending of messengers from Balak to Balaam, which is the background for Balak's complaint that Balaam did not come.
Balak again mentions the theme of honoring Balaam, but says that the Lord has kept him back from honor.
Similar use of the emphatic infinitive construction 'שָׁלֹחַ שָׁלַחְתִּי' (to send, I have sent) to express intensity.
God gave Balaam permission to go with the men, which explains why Balaam finally came to Balak.
